title: His second book: Enterprise AI Architect Guide
oneliner: His second book is out on Amazon - GenAI and AI agent architectures with practical implementation techniques and best practices from his own projects.
says: He announces his second book, the Enterprise AI Architect Guide, covering GenAI and AI agent architectures. It contains the practical implementation techniques he followed in his projects and the best practices for enterprise AI architects. It starts with the basic concepts - AI, GenAI, AI agents - how they are used effectively in enterprises, and how not to fail when implementing AI agent projects. He recommends it especially for consultants implementing AI agent projects.
explained: This reel is an announcement, but it doubles as a map of the channel's thesis. The book's arc - concepts, then enterprise application, then failure modes - is exactly the arc of his two seasons: Season 1 builds the infrastructure understanding, Season 2 builds the platform disciplines that keep AI projects from failing.

The 'how not to fail' framing is the tell about his audience. Most AI content sells possibility; his sells durability. If the reels are the free sample, the book is where he says the full implementation detail lives - worth knowing it exists when a reel leaves you wanting the checklist version.
takeaway: Announcement, not a lesson: the Enterprise AI Architect Guide (Amazon) is the long-form version of this channel's playbook.
